name: regismac
description: Sistema de gestión de producción RegisMac

scripts.build: cd regismac-frontend && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.build:backend: cd regismac-backend && npm ci && npx prisma generate
scripts.vercel-build: cd regismac-backend && npx prisma generate && cd ../regismac-frontend && npm install && vite build
scripts.migrate:deploy: cd regismac-backend && npx prisma migrate deploy
